_why: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B arrived 04.09.2026 and setup/env/qwen36.env carries TWO
flags it could not justify: the backend, and the absence of speculation.
This file is the 2x2 that decides both, and nothing else - deliberately
smaller than qwen38.json, because most of that file's axes do not exist
here.
WHY THE REASONING-LEVEL AXIS IS GONE. qwen38.json spends four of its
cells on xhigh/medium/low/none. This model's chat template has no such
dial: read out of the GGUF's own metadata 04.09.2026, it knows
enable_thinking and preserve_thinking and nothing else. So there is one
thinking setting to measure, not four, and the profile's
enable_thinking:false is carried into every cell rather than varied -
the sweep must not compare two things at once.
WHY THERE IS NO MTP CELL. The checkpoint HAS an MTP head
(mtp_num_hidden_layers: 1 in its config.json), but unsloth converts with
--no-nextn and ships GGUFs without it - the same reason flashnext needs a
separately exported head (setup/env/flashnext.env, unsloth discussion
#47). So -md has nothing to point at, and what CAN be asked here is the
n-gram drafter, which needs no second model at all. If a compatible head
is ever exported, that is a new question and gets a new variants file.
THE BUILD DIRECTORIES ARE NAMED, NOT SYMLINKED. build-rocm-patched is a
symlink and what it points at changes; a recorded cell may not. These
name b10702-11-gc799f1014, which is what that symlink resolved to on
-c 65536 throughout, -np 1, f16 KV, no --mmproj: clean single-stream
numbers, and the same window in every cell. @MODELS@ and @HOME@ are
expanded by setup/lib/systemdfile.py - never an absolute path, which
would tie this file to one checkout.

UPDATED 04.09.2026 after the three sideserver runs that settled the speculation question on ROCm: the ngram cells now carry --spec-draft-p-min 0.75, because that is what setup/env/qwen36.env serves and a sweep that measured a shape nobody runs would answer the backend question about the wrong configuration.

variants.name: rocm-nospec
variants.note: The baseline: exactly what setup/env/qwen36.env starts, at the sweep's window. Every other cell is read against this one.

variants.name: vulkan-nospec
variants.note: The backend, alone. It is a real question rather than a formality: the choice is model-dependent here and has flipped before - Vulkan won for Laguna WITHOUT speculation, ROCm won 2x for qwen38 WITH it (docs/MODELS.md, 24.08.), and this model starts without.

variants.name: rocm-ngram
variants.note: Speculation, alone, on the drafter that needs no second model. Read the COPY workload, not just count: this repo once recorded 'the ngram drafters give nothing' from a probe that could not have shown one working (bench/README.md).

variants.name: vulkan-ngram
variants.note: The fourth corner. Not decoration: with only the three cells above, a backend that wins without speculation and loses with it would look like a single verdict.
